82206512-cdab-4400-883b-748030bf8012.quote: Combustion adds splash burst whenever abilities land. Noxia needs a second, separate ability to hit the marked target, so Seismic Assault into Void Bomb is the natural trigger. Wraith Leggings adds damage against low-health heroes, and Oblivion Crown multiplies the power everything else scales from. Caustica ignores part of magical armor and gains damage against bonus magical armor on healthy targets, which suits Aurora's Flux Matrix and Frostguard. Spellbreaker's spell shield adds magical armor and extra power while it holds. Inventory does not show purchase order or how often each effect triggered.

Caustica ignores part of magical armor and gains damage against bonus magical armor on healthy targets, which suits Aurora's Flux Matrix and Frostguard. Spellbreaker adds magical armor, and its spell shield raises her power while it holds.
